value: You wake to a rising tide, the sea hungry to take back what it spit on the shore.
The smell of seaweed and rotten wood hangs in the air, and groaning from a fellow shipmate echoes through the fog.
You were the third crew to be sent to these shores. None had yet returned.
A faint mist of breath still escapes from your mouth as your sodden head rises from the mud.
Before your memory returns, a sharp pain stabs through your leg. Your last memory is of a defiled bear.
As your eyes adjust, a face stares down upon you.
